name: 3-nen 2-gumi wa Kurutteru
source:
――Bullying is being held in this class for 2 groups in 3rd year.
The whole class oppresses the "bullying target" called "joker".

"If you show a little reluctance to bully, you may be the next joker."

Such a brainwashed idea is planted, and everyone in the class desperately participates in bullying.
The 3rd year 2nd class was such a crazy class.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/19562]Freem![/url]]
translation:
――这个班级在三年级时分两组进行了欺凌行为。
全班欺压被称为“小丑”的“欺负对象”。

“如果你表现出一点不愿欺凌的行为，你可能就是下一个小丑。”

这样的洗脑思想被种下，班里的每个人都拼命参与欺凌行为。
三年级二班真是一个疯狂的班级。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/19562]Freem![/url]]
